svg.title: Calla lily — Kallalilja (Zantedeschia)
svg.desc: A calla lily has one folded funnel-like spathe around a separate upright spadix, held on a bare elegant stalk.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"flower-calla","label_en":"Calla lily","label_is":"Kallalilja (Zantedeschia)","section":"18","category_en":"Flowers, floral forms and floristry","category_is":"Blóm, blómgerðir og blómaskreytingar","batch":9,"tags":["botany","flower","zantedeschia"],"description":"A calla lily has one folded funnel-like spathe around a separate upright spadix, held on a bare elegant stalk.","design_note":"Zantedeschia is an aroid; the large scroll is a spathe, not a true lily petal.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
